meta_description: NXGN Services Ltd is your trusted emergency plumber in Wolverhampton. Fast response, honest pricing, all plumbing repairs and installations covered.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or blocked drain in Wolverhampton? We arrive fast, diagnose honestly, and fix right first time.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new installations, we handle every plumbing job with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We're on call 24/7 and aim to reach you in under an hour. Most common faults sorted same day.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Repair
services.desc: New boiler fitted with a 10-year guarantee and annual servicing plan. Emergency repairs covered any time of day or night.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Installations
services.desc: Full bathroom and kitchen overhauls, from pipe routing to tiling. We manage the lot — you just choose the finish.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: System design, installation, and annual maintenance. We keep your heating running reliably and efficiently all year.

services.title: Drain Unblocking & CCTV Surveys
services.desc: Blocked drains cleared fast using jet technology and electric eels. CCTV surveys identify hidden faults before they become emergencies.

services.title: Radiator & Pipe Repairs
services.desc: Cold radiators, burst pipes, and leaking joints repaired or replaced. We carry common parts on the van to keep downtime short.

about_pullquote: We fix plumbing right the first time — no return visits, no excuses.
about_para_1: NXGN Services was founded to bring honest, fast plumbing to Wolverhampton. For nearly two decades, we've built our reputation on turning up on time, diagnosing problems clearly, and fixing them properly. Our engineers carry the most common parts on the van, so many jobs finish the same day.
about_para_2: Customers trust us because we don't oversell. We tell you what's wrong, what it'll cost, and how long it'll take — then we get on with it. Whether it's a midnight burst pipe or a planned boiler swap, we bring the same professionalism and care every time.

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe at half ten on a Saturday night. Called NXGN and they were here by 11:15. Fixed it, showed me what had gone wrong, and the bill was exactly what they quoted on the phone. Can't ask for better than that.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: New boiler fitted last month. The lads were tidy, knew their stuff, and explained everything as they went. Heating is running beautifully now and the 10-year warranty gives me real peace of mind.
reviews.author: Linda P.

reviews.text: Blocked toilet on Christmas Eve — nightmare. NXGN came out same day, sorted it in twenty minutes with no fuss. Won't use anyone else now. Honest and professional.
reviews.author: David M.
